title: Outcome vocabulary — Retrieval-by-Outcome
description:
Retrieval-by-outcome starts from the desired end state — 'a printed replacement gear', 'a passing test suite', 'a quiet room' — and works backward to the resources that produce it. Callers often know what they want, not what it is called; this tool bridges that gap with an outcome index built from usage records, reviews, and procedure effects.
